info.description:
ShiftGuard helps managers review timecard exceptions with evidence-based suggestions, policy context, and explicit approval before any payroll record changes.

The system pairs deterministic timekeeping rules with a constrained LLM proposal layer. Every proposal is checked, simulated, audited, and routed to a manager; the demo controls make provider faults visible and reproducible.
